meta.title: Shiyu Runtime
meta.description: View Shiyu runtime state, current work and activity, and inspect Session connections.

title: Shiyu · Runtime
idleHint: No work is executing at the moment.
waitingHint: Waiting for a condition or result.
pausedHint: The runtime is paused. Its current state remains available.
unknownHint: The current runtime state cannot be confirmed.
degradedHint: Some runtime conditions are unavailable. Review the items needing attention.
staleHint: Showing the last successfully read snapshot.
snapshotOld: The snapshot is over 30 seconds old. Waiting for fresh state.
implementationHint: These entries describe implemented scope. See Overview and actual activity for runtime state.
sessionHint: Sessions registered by this runtime and their reported usage.
sessionSelect: Select a session to inspect it
hostDetached: This Shiyu instance is not attached to the Host Session.
hostUnknown: The snapshot does not provide a confirmed Host state.
usageHint: “Not reported” means data is unavailable; it does not mean zero.
probeHint: Creates an empty Session, checks access, then releases and archives it. No model is called.
probeDone: Session access checked. The temporary empty Session was released and archived; no model was called.
probeUnconfirmed: The check receipt does not confirm release, archive, or no model call. Inspect the current Session state.
pausedDone: Pause request completed and the state was refreshed.
resumedDone: Resume request completed and the state was refreshed.
modelVerify: Verify model and Session reuse (2 requests)
modelVerifyHint: Sends only 2 synthetic input turns, with at most 1,024 output tokens per turn.
modelVerifyLimits: Uses opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash (low). No automatic retries or outbound messages.
modelVerifyPending: Waiting for a result or cancellation receipt. Use “Pause runtime” to cancel.
modelVerifyDone: Model and Session reuse verified: 2 requests used the same Session, with no outbound message.
modelVerifyUnconfirmed: The receipt does not fully confirm 2 requests, the same Session, and no outbound message. The result is unconfirmed.
modelVerifyTimeout: No confirmed result after 250 seconds. Inspect the current state; no automatic retry will occur.
tasksHint: Inspect task records, completion criteria, and independent verification results.
tasksUnavailable: Task view is not connected yet
taskSelect: Select a task to inspect it
noUncertainty: No reconciliation reason or evidence recorded
stopPending: A stop request does not confirm cancellation. Execution and external effects still require reconciliation.
localTaskHint: Writes only note.txt in Shiyu’s dedicated directory. Uses deepseek-v4.1-flash (high), at most 2 model steps, and a total output budget of 1,024 tokens.
localTaskLimits: Runs in the background after admission. Success requires independent content and receipt verification. No automatic start or retry. Pause runtime cancels in-flight model work; unconfirmed outcomes remain unknown.
localTaskAccepted: Local task accepted ({id}). Completion depends on its task state and independent verification.
localTaskUnconfirmed: The task admission receipt is incomplete; acceptance is unconfirmed. Refresh task state. No automatic retry will occur.
taskNotInSnapshot: The selected task record is not in the current snapshot yet.
goalVerifyHint: Uses the latest successful local task, rechecks its artifact, then checks Goal creation, pause, resume, and completion. No model inference or outbound message is requested.
goalVerifyDone: Native Goal lifecycle checked: creation, pause, resume, and completion confirmed, with no model inference requested.
goalVerifyUnconfirmed: The Goal receipt does not fully confirm the task, Goal, Session, completion, no inference, and the four-step operation sequence. The result is unconfirmed.
conversationsHint: Inspect local conversation control records, task links, and background source versions. Chat and memory content are not displayed.
conversationsUnavailable: Conversation view is not connected yet
conversationSelect: Select a conversation to inspect it
conversationScopeUnknown: The snapshot contains a conversation with an unconfirmed scope. That record is not displayed.
conversationNotInSnapshot: The receipt’s conversation binding is not in the current snapshot. The link still needs confirmation.
conversationReadOnly: Viewing or refreshing does not load, consume, or acknowledge context, and does not confirm synchronization to a Session.
noPendingSources: No background update records. Current sources may still be awaiting their first load.
conversationLinkHint: Choose a local task to link to a conversation in the fixed local-owner scope. Defaults to the most recently updated task. Records control relationships only, without creating a Session, calling a model, or sending a message.
conversationLinkNeedsTask: Run local task validation first. The task need not be complete.
conversationLinkTaskMissing: The selected task is not in the current snapshot. Select a task again.
conversationLinkAccepted: Task link request accepted ({id}). Check the conversation snapshot for the link; this does not confirm that background context was loaded.
conversationLinkUnconfirmed: The receipt does not fully confirm this task, Conversation, and binding. The result is unconfirmed. Refresh to inspect it; no automatic retry will occur.
backgroundDeliveryHint: Pending and acknowledged delivery counts do not confirm that sources were loaded into a Session. Background markers may still arrive while paused.
backgroundUnavailable: Background delivery status is not connected yet
contextVerify: Verify context loading and Session reuse
contextVerifying: Verifying context loading and Session reuse…
contextVerifyHint: Explicitly runs 2 local synthetic model turns to check context loading and reuse of the same Session.
contextVerifyLimits: Uses opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash (low), with at most 512 output tokens per turn. Read-only, no outbound message, and no automatic retry.
contextVerifyNeedsTask: This conversation needs at least one linked task.
contextVerifyPending: Waiting for the context check receipt for Conversation ({id}). Use “Pause runtime” to cancel.
contextVerifyUnconfirmed: The receipt does not fully confirm this Conversation, binding, same Session, 2 requests, durable context acknowledgement, draft validation at each release, and no send. The result is unconfirmed.
contextVerifyTimeout: The context check timed out with no confirmed result. Refresh to inspect it; no automatic retry will occur.
contextVerifyReturned: A check receipt was received for Conversation ({id}). View it in that conversation’s details.
contextVerifyReceipt: Context check receipt from this operation
contextVerifyDone: This check passed: 2 turns reused one Session, context acknowledgement was persisted, each draft passed validation at release, and no message was sent.
contextVerifySnapshotOnly: Pending context still follows the service snapshot. This receipt does not clear background records in the page.
contextVerifyHistoryHint: This persisted record describes that check. It does not confirm the current context state or a pass for this operation.
contextSafetyUnavailable: Native context loading is unavailable. See dependency status in Diagnostics.
contextSafetyMissing: The native context readiness check is not connected yet.
contextAttemptedRoundsHint: Failures while reading a view or before model dispatch may still count as attempted turns. Use Session observations for actual model calls; this is not a complete billing measure.
memoryHint: Explicitly save local memory snippets and read saved content by record.
memoryWaitingHint: The service may not have started. Check the current dependency state.
memorySaveHint: Saves only after an explicit click. An unchanged snippet keeps its request ID. Refreshing never resubmits, and uncertain results are not retried automatically.
memoryBodyLimit: At most 16,384 UTF-8 bytes per snippet.
memorySaved: A save receipt was received. Use the latest snapshot to check the record state.
memoryDuplicate: This request already exists and was not submitted as a new save. Check its state in the snapshot.
memoryUnconfirmed: The memory receipt is incomplete. The result is unconfirmed; no automatic retry will occur.
memorySelect: Select a record to inspect its metadata
memoryBodyHint: The body is shown only temporarily in this page. Selecting another record, losing access, or withdrawing consent clears it.
memoryReadChanged: The selection or read permission changed during this read. The body was not displayed. Inspect the current record again.
memoryWithdrawHint: Withdrawal stops reads of this snippet. It does not mean the backend body was physically deleted. Withdrawal remains available while paused.
memoryWithdrawn: Read consent was withdrawn and the temporary body was cleared. This does not confirm physical deletion.
memoryWithdrawUnconfirmed: Withdrawal is unconfirmed and the temporary body was cleared. Refresh to inspect it; no automatic retry will occur.
memoryBusy: A memory request is running. Waiting for its receipt; no automatic retry will occur.
memoryNotInSnapshot: The selected memory record is not in the current snapshot.
commandUncertain: The result is unconfirmed. Refresh the state before deciding what to do next.
memorySemanticUnverified: Configured; embedding call not yet verified
memoryIndexHint: Saving and indexing are separate actions. Indexing explicitly calls local embeddings; refreshing does not.
memoryIndexUsageHint: Calls are cumulative for this index operation. A repeated request does not imply new calls.
memoryIndexed: The index has an independently verified receipt.
memoryIndexDuplicate: This index request already exists; it was not rerun. Showing cumulative operation evidence.
memoryIndexUnconfirmed: Index outcome is not confirmed. Check its status; no automatic retry.
memorySearchHint: Search only permitted memories in the conversation selected above. Results are references; no body is read and no query is saved automatically.
memorySearchNeedsIndex: Build the missing indexes first. Incomplete coverage cannot establish a match or no match.
memorySearchNoMatch: Index coverage was checked; no matching records were found.
memorySearchMatches: Matching references. Selecting one does not read its body.
memoryLastSemantic: Latest semantic operation (index usage is cumulative)
semanticUnconfirmed: The semantic receipt is incomplete; outcome unconfirmed. No automatic retry.
semanticResultChanged: Conversation, access or runtime identity changed; the result was not displayed.
contextLoadHint: Explicitly read permitted context and persist it in the native Session. No draft or outgoing message. Semantic retrieval, when enabled, uses local embeddings.
contextLoaded: Native context durability verified. No generation or followup requested; this does not verify a model answer.
contextLoadDuplicate: This input already has an operation record. It was not loaded or generated again.
contextLoadUnconfirmed: The native load receipt did not fully confirm this input and Session. Outcome unconfirmed.
